summary: The create path is right and in order: direct-proxy connect starts the pty host on demand, then pty-service.create-process, then start, and the node-pty spawn happens. Shell output streaming to the renderer (onProcessData -> LocalPty.handleData) is not modeled.

Corrected: only terminals with interaction survive a reload (an unused one is shut down), and persistTerminalState is not called on reload. The buffer is replayed from the live process on reattach. The model detaches correctly and reattaches correctly from a seeded state, but one run can't reconnect inside the 60 s grace time because a step waits for the previous step's timers. The replay is only a note.

Corrected: the pty host restarts (restartCount <= 5), and terminals do not reconnect. Normal terminals relaunch a new shell with a 'Restarting the terminal...' message, and feature terminals exit with -1. The model restarts the host but never tells the renderer, and leaves the dead pty in pty-service.ptys.

The DAP order initialize, launch, (initialized), setBreakpoints + setFunctionBreakpoints, configurationDone is reproduced. Gaps: start-da-session never starts the adapter, onDebugResolve:node is never activated so js-debug stays inactive, and full-window doesn't select the launch.json config, so F5 guesses a debugger.

Nothing models the adapter process exit ($acceptDAExit / onExit). The teardown from raw-debug-session.shutdown is modeled, but the 'Debug adapter process has terminated unexpectedly' notification and the 200 ms error-path disconnect are not.

The query with maxResults 20000 reaches ext-host-search.provide-text-search-results on eh1, but that provider is an unowned stub. There is no rg process, no streaming and no provider-side limit: with maxResults 2 it returns 8 fake (duplicated) results and limit_hit is false.

search.action.cancel is modeled as search-model.clear (results wiped). The code cancels the token, keeps the results, and the extension host kills rg. No token reaches the provider, and a search that is still running can't be cancelled because steps can't overlap.
